title: 第12章 坦诚交流
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
修仙，修仙，在普通凡人眼里，修士是仙人，是神明般的存在。

    便是修士，绝大部分人在测出灵根的懵懂时期，无论资质好坏，也都幻想着有朝一日能得道成仙，与天同寿。

    可一旦踏入修行，所有人都会认清现实，所谓成仙，不过是传说中的梦幻泡影。

    任你绝代风华，艳冠天下，到头来也是红粉骷髅；任你一代天骄，纵横无边山河，也终将化作一抔黄土。

    仙路漫漫，真正能一路走下去的人，亿万中寥寥无几，甚至比这个概率还低。

    而在燕国，元婴期便到顶了，距离飞升灵界何止十万八千里。

    说到底，修士也是人，与普通人没有本质上的区别，只不过是寿元可以更长久，有些超凡手段罢了。

    绝大多数人最终都不能免俗，终将归于平凡，结婚生子，繁衍后代……底层修士更是如此，这便是当今修行界的现状。

    齐云溪是万千之一，资质平庸，没有天降大机缘，这辈子几乎不可能踏入筑基延续后路，自然而然会对修行兴趣大减，不再执着，找个喜欢的人共度余生，便顺理成章成了最大的愿望。

    苏牧对她谈不上多么深的了解，但对其思想状态却度了个八九不离十。

    但他自己不一样。

    许是受到脑海里地球记忆的影响，他对修仙有非比寻常的执念。

    地球谁人没有修仙梦，却只存在于小说、影视之中，这辈子可以修炼了，说什么也得一刚到底。

    在他踏入青云宗的第一天起，便下定了决心，哪怕六十岁没能筑基，一百五十岁不能结丹，也会一直修炼下去，死也要死在修行的路上。

    而答应齐子濯，感恩对方照拂只是附加的心理因素。

    关键在于，与齐云溪结合，对他当下的修行有很大的帮助，综合各方面的考虑，利远远大于弊。

    如若不然，比齐子濯来头更大的人的要求，他都拒绝过。

    至于男女之情，他自然也有，却能克制住，生理需求什么的就更不用说，青楼逛一圈就解决了，又不是没去过。

    此刻，客厅桌前。

    面对齐云溪直白的真情表露，以及那眼神中的坚定，苏牧微微颔首道：“我有点要求，先与你说清楚。”

    齐云溪绷紧的心神瞬间松下，内心欢喜跃然脸上，却努力克制着不让嘴角的弧度更大，有些迫不及待道：“师兄请说！”
content_en:
Cultivation to immortality, cultivation of immortality, in the eyes of ordinary mortals, monks are immortals and god-like existences.

    Even monks, most people in the ignorant period when spiritual roots are being tested, regardless of their aptitude, also dream that one day they can attain enlightenment and become immortals, and live as long as heaven.

    But once they step into practice, everyone will realize the reality. The so-called immortality is just a dream in legend.

    No matter how magnificent you are, you will be crowned the world, but in the end you will be just a pink skeleton; no matter how proud you are, you will be able to traverse boundless mountains and rivers, but you will eventually turn into a handful of loess.

    The road to immortality is long, and there are only a few among the billions of people who can truly go all the way, and the probability is even lower than this.

    In the Yan Kingdom, the Nascent Soul stage has reached its peak, and the distance to ascend to the spiritual world is more than 100,000 miles away.

    After all, monks are also human beings, and they are not fundamentally different from ordinary people. They just have longer lifespans and some extraordinary means.

    The vast majority of people cannot escape the secular world in the end, and will eventually return to the ordinary, get married, have children, and reproduce offspring... This is especially true for the lower-level monks. This is the current situation in the spiritual world today.

    Qi Yunxi is one of thousands, with mediocre qualifications and no great opportunity. It is almost impossible for him to step into the foundation-building and continuation path in this life. Naturally, he will lose interest in practice, stop being persistent, and find someone he likes to spend the rest of his life with, which naturally becomes his biggest wish.

    Su Mu didn't know her very well, but he had an inseparable understanding of her state of mind.

    But he himself is different.

    Xu was influenced by the memory of the earth in his mind, and he had an unusual obsession with cultivating immortality.

    There is no one on earth who has no dream of cultivating immortality, but it only exists in novels, movies and TV shows. Now that you can practice cultivation in this life, you have to stick to it till the end.

    From the first day he entered the Qingyun Sect, he made up his mind that even if he failed to build the foundation at the age of sixty or the elixir at the age of one hundred and fifty, he would continue to practice and he would die on the road of cultivation.

    But agreeing to Qi Zizuo and being grateful for his care are just additional psychological factors.

    The key is that combining with Qi Yunxi will be of great help to his current practice. Taking all aspects into consideration, the advantages far outweigh the disadvantages.

    Otherwise, he would have refused the requests of people with greater background than Qi Zizuo.

    As for the love between men and women, he naturally has it, but he can control it. Not to mention physiological needs and so on, he can solve it by just visiting a brothel. It's not like he has never been there.

    At this moment, in front of the living room table.

    Faced with Qi Yunxi's straightforward expression of true feelings and the firmness in his eyes, Su Mu nodded slightly and said, "I have some requests. Let me make it clear to you first."

    Qi Yunxi's tense mind relaxed in an instant, and the joy in his heart showed on his face, but he tried hard to restrain the corners of his mouth from curling up, and said impatiently: "Senior brother, please tell me!"
